data.body: S4 (dc0d) implemented, validated, pushed as change 1023 (stack now 1023->1014->1012). Full gating suite GREEN: 7517 passed, 29 skipped, exit 0 (7505 + 12 new S4 tests). Commit 5d0840aec, rebar-ticket resolves, DCO signed, 50/72 gate passed. TWO ROUNDS were needed. Round 1: held-out oracle 11/12 — the single failure was MY test defect (patched pydantic_ai.models.openai when the builder guards pydantic_ai.providers.openai). Round 1 pre-flight then found 12 FULL-SUITE regressions that tests/unit missed: passing the model OBJECT to capabilities_for broke every model_override structured test (a FunctionModel test doubles own profile advertises json-schema, flipping output_mode to NativeOutput and exhausting the bounded retry) — 11 tests across 5 files, all Exceeded maximum output retries; plus test_unsupported_config_is_a_loud_error was left unreplaced despite being named in Scope. Re-stripped the oracle BEFORE re-dispatch (the S1 correction) and described the contract, not the tests. Round 2 fixed both exactly as specified: caps resolved ONCE in run() as capabilities_for(resolved if self._model_override is not None else model) and threaded into _pai_structured (removing a duplicate resolution); the loud-error test rewritten to assert the NEW validation contract rather than deleted. REVIEWER FINDING THAT IMPROVED MY ORACLE: it observed AC5 could be written to pass on the model object while production still passed the string, so I added a BOUNDARY test asserting no strict json_schema response_format reaches a custom endpoint; verified it bites (reverting to the string fails it AND the e2e recipe with LLMUnavailableError: Native...). The 11-test regression is itself the mutation evidence for the model_override guard. FILED task 2682 punctual-scavenger-fallowdeer (P1, discovered_from dc0d): runner.py now sits at EXACTLY the 800-LOC hard cap (gate uses >lim so it passes, zero headroom) and S3/S5 both still touch it; not fixed inside S4 because moving _pai_check_config to config.py (768 LOC) just relocates the pressure and a 30-LOC module violates the sub-100-LOC split rule — it needs real seam analysis.
